body: Instead of doing `is_class()` checks everywhere, you could instead add `bool is_editing_resource` or something, and set it when setting the edited object.
That's not really needed here I think. They are invisible anyway.

```suggestion
			set_name(TTRC("Resource"));
```
Same below.

```suggestion
		is_editing_resource  = (Object::cast_to<Resource>(selected_object) != nullptr)
```
Should it be replaced everywhere in this method, or just for this one ?
Only here, and maybe in `set_title()` below, since you are modifying these lines anyway.

Why is it static?
EDIT:
And duplicated in 2 classes 🙃

I made it static because you asked for it to be used in a static method, `ConnectDialog::generate_method_callback_name`. In hindsight, I probably should've asked for clarification.

Should I revert this, or keep it this way ?

EDIT:
Oh, I didn't even realize that I duplicated it too, this is because it's also in a different class.
Setting focus mode is unnecessary.
I just noticed, but why "independent"?
I set the focus mode here, because otherwise you could still get the blue highlight on the Groups button if you clicked on it.
That's not a problem. Disabled buttons can get focus.

The goal of this PR was originally to support connecting resource signals too, though this was abandoned and was instead converted to only support viewing resource signals. As such, there were some preparations made to be able to connect resource signals that have been left in, and a follow-up PR is already planned. Therefore I do not think this variable is irrelevant.

Duplicating it across 2 classes is kind of awkward though.

> As such, there were some preparations made to be able to connect resource signals that have been left in, and a follow-up PR is already planned.

All related changes should be in the follow-up, not here.

This variable is used to prevent crashes/errors when opening the connection dialog by double clicking, it cannot be removed.

> All related changes should be in the follow-up, not here.

Agreed, I will remove what I can.
But you can't open the dialog with double-click when a Resource is inspected, no?

I put "independent" because the EditorInspector needs to have a resource opened as the main object (either from the filesystem or from right clicking a resource in the inspector and clicking on "Edit"). I will admit "independent" isn't really a good word for it, but I couldn't come up with anything else at the time. I'm open to suggestions on this one
I removed the duplicated bool from `ConnectDialog`, since it was just being used in one place in that class, it's probably fine to just do `is_class("Resource")` there.

